body:
## Purpose
Add an in-tree adapter that exposes [KVCR](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/kvcr) as a vLLM secondary tier.

vLLM contains the factory registration and the translation between its secondary-tier interface and KVCR. KVCR remains an optional external package and owns the underlying storage, transfer, and policy implementation. Request-provided routing metadata is forwarded without making vLLM responsible for its semantics.

See the [KVCR README](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/kvcr#readme) for its architecture and supported capabilities.

This PR is stacked on #52067 and #52068.

## Test Plan

```
pytest -v \
    tests/v1/kv_offload/tiering/test_factory.py \
    tests/v1/kv_offload/tiering/test_kvcr_tier.py
```

The focused tests cover registration, configuration translation, request metadata forwarding, transfer status, block pinning, telemetry, policy selection, partial completion, and drain behavior.

This PR also adds KVCR to the KV connector CI, installing it from the KVCR main branch until a released wheel is available.
